notes.title: Memories of a development: how Inner Ashes was made
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755340/Inner_Ashes/

[June 30th is just around the corner, and that means that the release of Inner Ashes is imminent.[/b] We at Calathea Game Studio are very excited; very soon you will be able to enjoy our first game, and we hope it will be as unforgettable an experience as it was for us to create it.

If you are not familiar with Inner Ashes, let us give you a brief introduction. Our protagonist is Henry, a former forest ranger diagnosed with early Alzheimer's disease. After receiving a letter from his only daughter, Enid, he will embark on an introspective journey through his mind to try to remember why they grew apart. In the role of Henry and under a first-person perspective, you will explore dreamlike scenarios and solve puzzles to put his mind in order and reconstruct his past.

[u]Now, similar to Henry, we are going to recall and navigate through the memories of over four years of development that have led to Inner Ashes.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/bac98bda210cea916373f155dfac2ba8566b20d4.png[/img]

Inner Ashes was born as a joint Master's Thesis between four postgraduates. The original members of what is now Calathea Game Studio met there, as students who specialized in the different roles needed to make a video game (programming, design, 2D and 3D art, production and marketing).

[i]The initial idea at a playable level was to make a puzzle title, specifically a type of puzzle based on the concept of "two worlds" or "two realities"[/i]. This premise gave rise to the key aspect of what is now Inner Ashes: the story was to star a person with Alzheimer's disease. The reason for this was the relationship that all of the initial members of the design team had had with the disease, through their family members. The image of a person living between two worlds, one real and one distorted due to their mental state, immediately resonated with the team. We saw the opportunity to tell a story that felt close to us, and at the same time to make visible a disease suffered by millions of people around the world.

In fact, [i]during its first months of development and before having a definitive name, the game was known internally as Project Ithaca. This reference to a man's journey through different islands was kept in the final game, but in a metaphorical sense[/i]; the journey was to the inside of his mind, and the "islands" were the different dream scenarios Henry visited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/60bec0221d6d851a915ee626ee327085e07cb9d7.jpg[/img]

With the aforementioned objective of giving visibility to a real disease, from the beginning it was clear to us that we had to do it with rigor. The documentation work was fundamental from the beginning of the development, and we have been honored to have the advice of someone expert in the field: [b]Marisa Delgado, PhD in Psychology and specialist in aging and neurodegenerative diseases (and professor at the Complutense University of Madrid).
[/b]
From her we learned, among many other things, that Alzheimer's does not have fixed phases, but symptoms; and that these can affect each patient with a different order and intensity (and even not affect them at all, since not all symptoms affect all people). These symptoms (ranging from short-term memory loss to mood swings or orientation problems, including motor and language difficulties) are reflected in the game through the scenarios that Henry goes through in search of answers. With this in mind, what we propose with Inner Ashes is a story based on an artistic interpretation of the many possible realities of people with the disease.

[b]This research was also reflected in the gameplay mechanics, which are inspired by real therapies that Alzheimer's patients use to mitigate the symptoms of the disease.[/b] For example, one of Henry's everyday objects are post-its, in which he writes down tasks or names of objects, and that in his "mental world" will serve to interact with elements of the scenario and solve puzzles. And speaking of puzzles, the tangrams that our protagonist uses to keep his mind agile will have special importance when unlocking key memories of his past with Enid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/0e7e3d9548e285a94ef42c313af3e31eb382a9d5.jpg[/img]

In the long road of making Inner Ashes, [i]PlayStation has played a very important role. One of our main achievements as a team was the PlayStation Special Commitment Award[/i], given at the VI PlayStation Awards gala. It was a reaffirmation that we were on the right track, and encouraged us to enter the PlayStation Talents program in early 2020, already with the firm objective of developing and launching a game in which we were increasingly confident.

That year brought us one of the biggest development challenges: the pandemic. COVID-19 disrupted, among many other things, our way of working. For three years, a Discord channel has been our "office"; there we have shared meetings, previews, edited trailers, solved bugs... We have seen each other in person less often than we would have liked, but we have managed to keep the 16 people who currently make up the studio (with an identical proportion of women and men, something we are particularly proud of) as a united team. All in all, we are aware of what a privilege it has been to be able to continue with the development of a video game (and finish it) in such a global context.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/38d1a56d35c0d470f7890784f98667efee4d1bc0.png[/img]

[b]In this review we cannot forget you, male and female players. [/b]In the last few years, we have been able to take Inner Ashes to video game fairs and events all over Spain, and your reactions to the game gave us encouragement to keep going. In addition, the aforementioned award from PlayStation has been followed by [b]six other awards in various events, rewarding aspects such as visuals or soundtrack[/b].

During these years we have seen Henry and Enid "grow", and we don't want to say goodbye without asking you to immerse yourself in their story and embrace their message. A touching story that speaks of fears and insecurities, but also (and above all) of tolerance and love. Back in 2019, we advocated that video games have an impact on society, and that it is our responsibility to make it positive and memorable; this title is the materialization of that idea.

[h3]Enjoy Inner Ashes.[/h3]
Don't forget to add Inner Ashes to your wishlist, remember that the game will also be available from June 30 on [url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pclhgv00r60]Xbox[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10006351]PlayStation[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/inner-ashes-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url].

notes.title: The gameplay of Inner Ashes: playing with memories
notes.notes:
Today we start our dev diary: In this installment of the development diary of Inner Ashes we are going to talk about a key section of the game: [b]the gameplay[/b].

As you may already know, Inner Ashes is first and foremost a narrative adventure. [b]This implies that the plot is of paramount importance[/b], and the different aspects of the gameplay support this idea; everything we do, both main objectives and secondary collectibles, serves to learn more about Henry and Enid's story.

You will begin the game in Henry's house; what in the initial stages of development started as just a kitchen now also includes a study and a large living room. [b]We encourage you to investigate every detail of this setting[/b], as the story of our protagonist is also told through photos, drawings and even everyday utensils. In addition, some elements will change as the adventure progresses, so that browsing through the different rooms will never be superfluous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/1cbfab64e7fa2abf55d995a507443c5823392d95.png[/img]

For our former forester, his journey begins without leaving home. Since his goal is to put his memories in order, it is inside his mind that he will have to find his way. Thus, dreamlike landscapes await you in which Henry's difficulties to remember take the form of different puzzles, from finding a key to reactivating a water mill, while facing a blizzard. Moreover, all these obstacles and the context in which they are presented are closely linked to the various symptoms of Alzheimer's that Henry suffers from.

And how can you overcome these adversities? With an object that Henry uses in his daily life:[b]post-its. [/b]These sticky notes, being ideal for remembering, will allow you to store the "essence" of certain objects and then use them in the right place. As for which objects, and which places, again the plot will be the central axis; Henry will talk to himself and remember conversations with other people, and in his words there will often be clues to solve the challenges he encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/558e9db7671d389faea10d4a46f131bfbe35be77.png[/img]

Another important mechanic is [b]tangrams[/b], a set of puzzles that Henry himself uses to keep his mind in shape. In his subconscious, these types of puzzles with geometric shapes will indicate particularly relevant memories; as you delve deeper into Henry's mind, their difficulty will increase, as will the importance of the revelations they conceal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/37a1f836bf8635ab3eb03733f35ff45ea748334f.png[/img]

However, Henry's memories hide more than meets the eye. In them there are also [b]optional collectibles[/b], so we encourage you to calmly explore the dreamlike scenarios that make up the mind of our protagonist. Who knows what information about his past you may find...

We are looking forward to June 30 to enjoy Inner Ashes. Add Inner Ashes to your Steam, [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/inner-ashes-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10006351]PlayStation[/url] wishlist now, coming soon to Xbox.

notes.title: Inner Ashes: The exposure of social issues in videogames.
notes.notes:
[b]Inner Ashes [/b]and other titles that address social and mental issues are just the beginning of a growing movement to make video games more inclusive and accessible to a diverse audience and to address important [i]mental health topics.[/i]

In the last decade, video games have become a powerful tool for raising awareness of social issues and increasing understanding about them. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/419460/That_Dragon_Cancer/]That Dragon Cancer [/url]y [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/501300/What_Remains_of_Edith_Finch/]What Remains of Edith Finch[/url] sare examples of games that address sensitive and profound topics and have been recognized for their valuable contributions to video game culture. Other games in this category include  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1225590/Sea_of_Solitude/]Sea of Solitude[/url], which also addresses mental health in general, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1126600/Before_I_Forget/]Before I Forget[/url], a first-person adventure where the player takes on the role of a woman with dementia struggling to maintain her memories.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755340/Inner_Ashes/

In particular, Inner Ashes has focused on a disease that affects millions of people worldwide: Alzheimer's, [b] not only to raise awareness about the disease but also to help players understand and empathize with those who suffer from it. [/b]

Inner Ashes is a [b]first-person narrative puzzle adventure [/b], that tells the story of Henry, a park ranger diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's, who must delve into his mind to find answers about his daughter and his memories. The importance of Alzheimer's in Inner Ashes is not coincidental, as the game's design team had lived with this disease up close. [u][b]The duality between Henry's real world and subconscious is reflected in the game's artistic section, with dreamlike scenarios representing the different symptoms of the disease.[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/0a3c95a1b92823deb17e83397abb8ddc66d92122.jpg[/img]
Since the game's design team had lived with the disease through their family members, [b][u] the playable challenges are based on real therapy methods for Alzheimer's patients.[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/1cbfab64e7fa2abf55d995a507443c5823392d95.png[/img]
Soon we will release a [u][b]devlog[/b][/u] with weekly news about the creation process of Inner Ashes, giving a glimpse into the game's development. Don't forget to add Inner Ashes to your  [u][b]wishlist[/b][/u] to stay up to date on the latest game news.

notes.title: Inner Ashes is a first-person journey of discovery.
notes.notes:
Have you ever played a videogame that you thought you couldn't forget it under any circumstances? Well, you're wrong. Yes, the video game is a first level artistic language. Yes, its evocative capacity has no limits. But no, nothing guarantees that you will always remember it. In fact, nothing guarantees that you will remember even your children, siblings or friends. Because the human brain is a fragile organ subject to many risks. One of them is Alzheimer's disease. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/e167ae16152c675011f5bee9ac7821d16f7347d8.png[/img]

[b]Inner Ashes[/b], Calathea Game Studio's debut feature game, manages to put you in the shoes of those who suffer from it. 

It is curious how a videogame that talks about oblivion is, at the same time, difficult to forget (although not impossible, as we have said). A title unlike any other, which deserves to be in your [i][u][b]wishlist.  [/b][/u][/i]

A courageous work that speaks of our fears and our realities, [i]Inner Ashes is an experience of self discovery. A first-person adventure in which you will have to go through dreamlike scenarios, endowed with a melancholic peace, an uncomfortable placidity. In them you will find challenges, in the form of addictive puzzles or collectibles, that recreate the obstacles that an Alzheimer's patient overcomes in his day to day. [/i]

Among the best aspects of Inner Ashes, we can mention its [b]touching soundtrack and the delicacy of its art direction[/b]. These elements achieve an immersive experience to empathically connect with Henry, the protagonist, diagnosed with Alzheimer's, who needs to reconcile with his daughter before forgetting her forever. 

[b]For a very affordable price[/b], you can immerse yourself in this different, human, exciting game. [b]Add to your wishlist[/b],  don't miss the opportunity to discover the capacity that videogames like Inner Ashes have to awaken our purest feelings. And don't forget it, as long as possible. 

Stay tuned, soon we will be announcing gameplay details about [b]Inner Ashes[/b]

notes.title: Inner Ashes: A first-person mind-exploration adventure game
notes.notes:
From [url=https://www.selecta-vision.com/selecta-play-new/][b]SelectaPlay[/b][/url] and [b]Calathea Game Studio[/b], we are pleased to announce that [b]Inner Ashes[/b], a first-person adventure that explores the intrigues of the human mind, will be available next June 30th on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755340/Inner_Ashes/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/inner-ashes-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10006351]PlayStation[/url] y Xbox.

[previewyoutube=2GU0JhW8Xa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Inner Ashes is a unique and heartbreaking [b]first-person adventure[/b] that takes you into the shoes of Henry, a forest ranger who has been diagnosed with early-stage Alzheimer's disease. Explore his mind to discover why his only daughter, Enid, disappeared from his life. Travel through unique and dreamlike scenarios based on Henry's daily life and mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282689/9d7a37229a38e743fc05588fa9e14ee284fe6ce5.jpg[/img]

The [b]game mechanics[/b] of Inner Ashes are immersed in elements used to help Alzheimer's sufferers mitigate their symptoms. Solve tangram [b]puzzles[/b] to stimulate Henry's memory and allow him to unlock key memories of his life with his daughter Enid. Use post-its to help Henry recognize objects, remember how to use them and unlock memories from the past.

[i]With this game we bet on a different premise, contemporary, emotional, human to the bone, with a dreamlike world to explore, full of puzzles to solve and a learning narrative that will make you better understand life, recreating through metaphors the progression of Alzheimer's disease, in a respectful and, yes, also entertaining way.[/i].
